title: Jonah and the Extraction
author: Tamsin Eriksen
blurb: Jonah Vane, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
